images.caption: Figure 1:Overview of WebArena-Pro.(A) Domain heterogeneity.WebArena-Pro spans 20 self-hosted web applications across six domain categories (productivity, communication, analytics, business operations, design and media, and travel), each modeled on a widely used service such as Notion, Slack, Spotify, Figma, or Airbnb. The full set of applications and their reference services are listed in Table2.(B) Multimodal observation and action space.WebArena-Pro extends the agent’s observation space beyond text and vision to include audio and video. Embedded media sources are exposed to the agent through the accessibility tree, and agents invoketranscribe()andextract_frames()actions to convert temporal media into a form usable during browser workflows. If the agents handle native audio and video processing, they invokelisten()andwatch()actions.
